title: Song Pal Loop
style: Phonk with swung half-time drums, eerie brass stabs, dusty sample chops and chesty sub-bass; verse rides sparse percussion and callout ad-libs, pre-chorus narrows to claps and filtered chant, chorus hits with boxy crowd vocals and chopped horn replies. Lead vocal is close-mic and gritty, with doubled hook lines, panned echoes, and short delay throws. Reverse swells, vinyl crackle, and a bass riser flip into each drop; mix is dark, punchy, and wide, rap, deep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey shares the lane
where we meet and lean
Songpal.ai in the air
bilingual, clean

The kids go, "Rapper Raffa Raps!"
Hands up, stamp the floor
DJ Zyn Rose on the beat
we want a little more

Sneaky panther in the back
brass flash, then ghost
Thrift drift, turn the page
what we trade, we boast

Yo digo "vamos" loud
你听我唱, all day
We talk in one long loop
then we throw it back your way

[Pre-Chorus]
Lay that rhythm down
spin it, spin it now
Upside down, little smile
make the whole room howl

A.I. on the tongue
song pal in my chest
Hear it in Spanish first
then Mandarin feels best

[Chorus]
Song pal like a pen pal
unreal, unreal
Song pal like a pen pal
feel it, feel it, feel

Corey A I
Song Pal A I
Rap Rap Rap
let the whole room fly

Song pal, sing pal
we sing pal tonight
Song pal, sing pal
make it feel right

[Verse 2]
I sing aloud, you hear my sound
so dear, so near
Say it back, digger deep
make the meaning clear

Do that dance, or just a glance
one snap, one grin
Tengo fuego in the clap
let the whole thing spin

不怕慢, just ride
one pulse, one time
From the thrift drift corner
to the front line shine

A song pal, we sing pal
that's the thread we keep
Back and forth, side by side
wide awake, not asleep

[Pre-Chorus]
Lay that rhythm down
spin it, spin it now
Upside down, little smile
make the whole room howl

A.I. on the tongue
song pal in my chest
Hear it in Spanish first
then Mandarin feels best

[Chorus]
Song pal like a pen pal
unreal, unreal
Song pal like a pen pal
feel it, feel it, feel

Corey A I
Song Pal A I
Rap Rap Rap
let the whole room fly

Song pal, sing pal
we sing pal tonight
Song pal, sing pal
make it feel right

[Bridge]
Where we meet, where we meet
side by side, face to face
One world, two tongues
same beat, same space

说出来, sing it out
dilo fuerte, don't hide
Corey shares the spark
and we all take the ride

[Chorus]
Song pal like a pen pal
unreal, unreal
Song pal like a pen pal
feel it, feel it, feel

Corey A I
Song Pal A I
Rap Rap Rap
let the whole room fly

Song pal, sing pal
we sing pal tonight
Song pal, sing pal
make it feel right
